actions.description: Create a comment in ClickUp on a task or list
actions.name: create-comment

task_id.description: ClickUp Task ID to comment on. Example: "86c9w2nke"

list_id.description: ClickUp List ID to comment on. Example: "901523451693"

comment_text.description: The text content of the comment

space_id.description: Space ID where the folder will be created. Example: "901511023604"

name.description: Name of the folder to create. Example: "New Folder"
Name of the goal. Example: "Q1 Revenue Target"

team_id.description: ClickUp team ID. Optional - uses metadata if not provided. Example: "90152560096"

due_date.description: Due date in milliseconds since epoch. Example: 1704067200000

description.description: Description of the goal. Example: "Increase revenue by 20% in Q1"

multiple_owners.description: Whether the goal can have multiple owners.

color.description: Color code for the goal in hex format. Example: "#ff0000"

owners.description: Array of owners for the goal

name.description: The name of the list to create. Example: "My List"

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to create the list in. Use this to create a list inside a folder. Either folder_id or space_id must be provided. Example: "901516078072"

space_id.description: The ID of the space to create the list in. Use this to create a folderless list directly in a space. Either folder_id or space_id must be provided. Example: "901511023376"

content.description: The description or content of the list.

due_date.description: The due date for the list in milliseconds since epoch.

due_date_time.description: Whether the due_date includes time information.

priority.description: The priority level of the list (1-4, where 1 is Urgent).

assignee.description: The user ID to assign to this list.

status.description: The status of the list (refers to list color, not task statuses).

team_id.description: ClickUp team ID (workspace). Uses connection metadata if not provided. Example: "90152560096"

multiple_assignees.description: Whether tasks can have multiple assignees

list_id.description: The ID of the list to create the task in. Example: "901523451693"

description.description: The description of the task (supports Markdown).

assignees.description: Array of user IDs to assign to the task.

status.description: The status of the task (e.g., "to do", "in progress", "complete").

due_date.description: Due date as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

start_date.description: Start date as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

tags.description: Array of tag names to apply to the task.

parent.description: ID of the parent task (for subtasks).

actions.description: Create a time entry in ClickUp
actions.name: create-time-entry

start.description: Start time in milliseconds since Unix epoch

task_id.description: Task ID to associate with the time entry. Example: "abc123"

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable

tags.description: Tags to associate with the time entry

comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to delete. Example: "90150225604615"

success.description: Whether the comment was successfully deleted

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to delete. Example: "901516078072"

goal_id.description: The ID of the goal to delete. Example: "2def2fe3-90cb-4332-8d3e-ba04e38c67ef"

success.description: Whether the goal was successfully deleted

actions.description: Delete a list in ClickUp. This is a permanent delete and all tasks inside the list are also deleted.
actions.name: delete-list

list_id.description: The ID of the list to delete. Example: "901523451693"

taskId.description: The ID of the task to delete. Example: "86c9w2nke"

actions.description: Delete a time entry in ClickUp
actions.name: delete-time-entry

time_entry_id.description: The ID of the time entry to delete. Example: "5090290025624291206"

actions.description: Retrieve a single folder from ClickUp.
actions.name: get-folder

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to retrieve. Example: "901516078072"

actions.description: Retrieve a single goal from ClickUp
actions.name: get-goal

actions.description: Retrieve a single list from ClickUp.
actions.name: get-list

listId.description: The ID of the list to retrieve. Example: "901523451693"

actions.description: Retrieve a single space from ClickUp
actions.name: get-space

actions.description: Retrieve a single task from ClickUp.
actions.name: get-task

custom_task_ids.description: Set to true when using custom task IDs instead of ClickUp native IDs.

team_id.description: ClickUp team/workspace ID. Required when custom_task_ids is true. Example: "90152560096"

actions.description: Retrieve a single time entry from ClickUp
actions.name: get-time-entry

time_entry_id.description: The ID of the time entry to retrieve. Example: "5090290025624291206"

actions.description: Retrieve a single workspace member from ClickUp.
actions.name: get-user

task_id.description: Task ID to list comments from. Example: "abc123". Either task_id or list_id must be provided.

list_id.description: List ID to list comments from. Example: "123". Either task_id or list_id must be provided.

actions.description: List folders from a ClickUp space
actions.name: list-folders

space_id.description: The ID of the space to list folders from. Example: "901511023604"

archived.description: Include archived folders. Defaults to false.

folder_id.description: Folder ID to list lists within. Provide either folder_id or space_id, not both.

space_id.description: Space ID to list folderless lists directly in the space. Provide either folder_id or space_id, not both.

archived.description: Whether to include archived lists. Default: false.

actions.description: List tasks from a ClickUp list with optional filtering and pagination
actions.name: list-tasks

list_id.description: List ID to fetch tasks from. Example: "901523451693"

page.description: Page number (0-based). Omit for first page

due_date_gt.description: Filter by due date greater than (ms epoch)

due_date_lt.description: Filter by due date less than (ms epoch)

date_created_gt.description: Filter by date created greater than (ms epoch)

date_created_lt.description: Filter by date created less than (ms epoch)

date_updated_gt.description: Filter by date updated greater than (ms epoch)

date_updated_lt.description: Filter by date updated less than (ms epoch)

start_date.description: Start date in milliseconds since epoch to filter time entries

end_date.description: End date in milliseconds since epoch to filter time entries

assignee.description: User ID to filter time entries by assignee

include_task_tags.description: Include task tags in the response

include_location_names.description: Include location names in the response

space_id.description: Space ID to filter time entries

folder_id.description: Folder ID to filter time entries

list_id.description: List ID to filter time entries

task_id.description: Task ID to filter time entries

comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to update. Example: "90150225604615"

comment_text.description: The new text content of the comment.

assignee.description: The user ID to assign the comment to. Optional.

resolved.description: Whether the comment is resolved. Optional.

id.description: The ID of the folder to update. Example: "901516078072"

name.description: The new name for the folder. Example: "Updated Folder Name"

goal_id.description: The ID of the goal to update. Example: "2def2fe3-90cb-4332-8d3e-ba04e38c67ef"

due_date.description: The due date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

multiple_owners.description: Whether the goal has multiple owners

color.description: The color of the goal in hex format

list_id.description: The ID of the list to update. Example: "901523451693"

name.description: The new name of the list.

content.description: The new content/description of the list.

due_date.description: The due date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

due_date_time.description: Whether the due_date includes a time component.

priority.description: The priority of the list (1-4, where 1 is Urgent).

assignee.description: The user ID to assign the list to.

space_id.description: The ID of the space to update. Example: "901511023604"

name.description: The new name for the space.

color.description: The color of the space in hexadecimal format.

admin_can_manage.description: Whether admins can manage the space.

multiple_assignees.description: Whether tasks in the space can have multiple assignees.

priority.description: Priority level: 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Normal, 4 = Low

due_date.description: Due date in milliseconds since epoch

start_date.description: Start date in milliseconds since epoch

add.description: Array of numeric user IDs to add as assignees

rem.description: Array of numeric user IDs to remove from assignees

actions.description: Update a time entry in ClickUp.
actions.name: update-time-entry

timer_id.description: The ID of the time entry to update. Example: "5090290025624291206"

description.description: The description of the time entry.

start.description: The start time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tid.description: Task ID to associate the time entry with.

tags.description: List of tag names to apply to the time entry.
